content:
raj: kicking off follow-up from the last canary outage. we agreed on several items in the postmortem but need to assign owners and short timelines. main gaps: too-large initial rollouts, weak rollback signal diversity, no enforced safety caps at control-plane.
ana: typo: Ana not nana :)
raj: oops, fixed. Ana: I can take ownership of rollout gating rules.
jiao: I can do investigation + dashboarding for recurring patterns (which flags/rollouts hit incidents).
ben: I'll cover control-plane enforcement + console UX for developers.
sam: I'll iterate on rollback signals and the rollback playbook (what to collect, how to annotate tickets).
raj: ok list of actions:
- A1: Control-plane safety enforcement (reject rollouts violating caps). Owner: ben. Deliverable: server-side reject + audit event. ETA: 2025-04-01. Priority: P0.
- A2: Blast-radius circuit-breaker: auto-halt on >X instances or >Y% users. Owner: ana. Deliverable: policy + infra implement + tests. ETA: 2025-03-28. Priority: P0.
- A3: Rollout-pattern dashboard. Owner: jiao. Deliverable: Kibana/console dashboard linking FF ids to incidents and signal spikes. ETA: 2025-04-08. Priority: P1.
- A4: Multi-signal auto-rollback revamp. Owner: sam. Deliverable: new policy, simulator, and a runbook update. ETA: 2025-03-30. Priority: P0.
- A5: Short-term freeze+signoff mitigation. Owner: ben. Deliverable: pipeline check for rollouts >0.1% requiring platform+oncall ok. ETA: 48h. Priority: P0.
- A6: Rollback telemetry snapshot. Owner: sam. Deliverable: attach sampled request traces + 5xx traces + error hist to incident ticket on rollback. ETA: 2025-03-30. Priority: P0.
raj: for A4, propose we use a voting model: require 2 of 3 signal classes to trip (errors, latency tail, downstream error rate). window sizes: 60s for errors, 120s for p95, 180s for downstream failures. also include min-user-sample.
sam: agree, here's example policy JSON (WIP):
```json
{
  "id": "rb_v2_voting",
  "voting": {
    "required": 2,
    "signals": [
      {"name": "5xx_rate", "threshold": 0.03, "window_s": 60},
      {"name": "p95_latency_ms", "threshold": 1500, "window_s": 120},
      {"name": "downstream_error_ratio", "threshold": 0.02, "window_s": 180}
    ],
    "min_requests": 50
  },
  "actions": ["rollback","create_incident","notify:oncall"]
}
```
ana: For blast-radius circuit-breaker (A2) my thinking: default caps = min(1% of active users, 5 instances). we should allow override via explicit emergency override with 2 approvers (platform + oncall).
ben: Implementation note: enforcement must be idempotent and fail-safe. if control-plane cannot evaluate cap due to telemetry lag, default to rejecting the rollout (fail closed).
jiao: Dashboard will surface historical rollouts, their initial percent, which cluster, and whether any of the new signals tripped in the next 30m. I'll seed it with last 90 days of data.
raj: short-term mitigation: freeze window for all new canaries between 11:00-14:00 PT for the next week. Ben can you add pipeline hook and alert to #oncall when someone attempts outside window?
ben: yep - adding pipeline hook. PR in progress: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/905 (draft).
sam: regarding telemetry snapshot (A6), we'll include last 500 request traces, top 10 error stacks, and aggregated user-ids (hashed) of affected requests. privacy check: no PII.
ana: training/action: add a short checklist for engineers opening rollouts: include risk level, fallback plan, owner, and target metric to watch. Owner: ana. ETA: 2025-03-20.
raj: excellent. tracking tickets: INF-3501 (control-plane caps), INF-3502 (circuit-breaker), INF-3503 (dashboard), INF-3504 (rollback-voting), INF-3505 (telemetry-snapshot), INF-3506 (pipeline-freeze). please comment on your ticket when you start work.
rollout-bot: New canary attempt blocked by policy: rollout id r-20250312-77 blocked (violated cap).
ben: confirmed the blocked event is from a dev run. PR will include clearer UX messaging.
jiao: I'll add an automated note to tickets when a blocked rollout occurs so PMs know why.
sam: timeline check-ins: let's do 2x weekly standups until P0 closed. first standup: 2025-03-18 10:00 PT.
raj: agreed. last note: collect recurrence markers in INF-3503 so we can measure whether these changes reduce repeat incidents by 50% over 90 days.
ben: :thumbsup:
ana: :white_check_mark:
sam: :white_check_mark:
raj: closing thread, will reopen with blockers or when major PRs land.
